heading: Privacy of assessment results
lead: Any results from an individual assessment referred to in this chapter of a student that become part of the education records of the student shall have the protections provided in section 1232g of this title.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 7903, Pub. L. 89–10, title IX, § 9203, as added Pub. L. 103–382, title I, § 101, Oct. 20, 1994, 108 Stat. 3798, set forth purpose of provisions relating to Native Hawaiian educational programs, prior to the general amendment of former subchapter IX of this chapter by Pub. L. 107–110.
